authority: Ministry of Housing, Communities & Local Government
note: Previously unused official public no-login source window. Current Planning Data Local plan boundary dataset contains polygon/multipolygon coverage areas and permanent references for local plans. Up to 50 records were considered as the bounded source window. The fixed future_growth_3 owner/partition/checkpoint still exposes no authoritative local-plan-boundary reference/name, local-plan reference/name, responsible organisation code, LPA/LAD identifier/name, postcode, UPRN, coordinate/grid reference, or equivalent selector. Therefore none of the official coverage polygons can be bound to this slot without guessing. No coverage_area_id is selected, no source-area geometry is emitted, no parcel is accepted, and no Plan0 package is emitted.
